propose.description: Create an immutable design candidate as a draft. This does not adopt the design.

amend.description: Create a new proposal version. Previous approvals are not reused.

submit.description: Operate on this exact proposal version. Commit requires current owner conditions and explicit human approval.

rebase.description: Operate on this exact proposal version. Commit requires current owner conditions and explicit human approval.

withdraw.description: Operate on this exact proposal version. Commit requires current owner conditions and explicit human approval.

commit.description: Adopt this exact candidate after current owner conditions and explicit human approval; record the optional final reason.

endorse.description: Record the affected owner review with its reason.

object.description: Record the affected owner review with its reason.

retract_review.description: Record the affected owner review with its reason.

review_adoption.description: Human adoption review. Agent credentials cannot approve adoption.

publish_candidate.description: Share this fixed candidate with authorized subscribers/dependents. It remains unadopted.

record.description: Record an artifact reference, observation, result, operation or question. Cannot change an adopted design.

capture_artifact.description: Store base64 bytes (32 MiB/file, 64 MiB/request) or assemble ordered saved file parts. No nested parts. Up to 10000 logical files and 1 GiB total.

restore_artifact.description: Return saved bytes or metadata_only manifest. Chunked files require read_artifact_chunk; hashes cover each part and the complete file.

read_artifact_chunk.description: Read one hash-verified part, at most 32 MiB. Ordinary files have only index 0.

reconcile_work_basis.description: Acknowledge an upstream update, keeping the old version with a reason or switching explicitly.

discuss.description: Record a discussion with fixed evidence revision IDs. basis is the common event provenance object; evidence is a list of immutable references.

identity.description: Read the authenticated identity, without credentials.

review_context.description: Read a consistent snapshot of the candidate diff, evidence, evaluations, work and review permissions.

context.description: Read work context. Full is unchanged. Focused requires entry_ids, follows declared dependencies in the fixed design, and pages related discussion. Explicit omissions are not an impact analysis or approval.

events.description: Poll durable notices from a ledger sequence cursor; deduplicate by event_id.
